title: 保险丝烧断了  (A Blown Fuse)

segments.t: 在没有光线的走廊里，刚把那张沉重的橡木桌搬下楼，亚瑟就伸手去摸墙上的旧式黄铜开关。在这个场景中，你还会听到楼上传来泰莎和格雷厄姆的声音。请先听一遍。
Wait one minute before touching that brass switch, Arthur.
Why wait? I remember this glass ceiling lamp. Watch how prettily it glows!
Arthur, wait! Graham has his screwdriver out!
Just one quick click... pop! Oh dear.
What was that loud pop in the hallway?!
That was the old wire blowing the main first floor fuse.
The lobby lamp went dark! Did I break the kitchen oven too?!
Oh no, I can hear Tessa calling from the dark kitchen right now!
Thirty year old cloth wire, boss. Never flip a switch before I look inside.
Can you fix it before lunch, Graham? Please say you have spare fuses!
I can reset the kitchen in two minutes, but Room Nine needs new copper wire.
Hold the flashlight steady, Arthur. Our six day countdown just got real!
现在，让我们仔细听听每一句对话。
Wait one minute before touching that brass switch, Arthur.
‘在按那个黄铜开关之前先等一分钟，亚瑟。’
before touching
在这里指的是触摸或者用手去拨动开关。
Why wait? I remember this glass ceiling lamp. Watch how prettily it glows!
‘为什么要等？我记得这盏玻璃吊灯。看它闪耀得多漂亮啊！’在英语口语中，
Why wait?
经常直接作为问句使用，而不带动词。
Arthur, wait! Graham has his screwdriver out!
‘亚瑟，等等！格雷厄姆已经把螺丝刀拿出来了！’
has his screwdriver out!
生动地展现了工具已经拿在手里，准备好投入使用。
Just one quick click... pop! Oh dear.
‘就快速点一下……砰！哎呀，糟糕。’表示轻微的惊吓或者事情出了点小差错时，英语常说
Oh dear.
这是一种非常委婉得体的惊叹。
What was that loud pop in the hallway?!
‘走廊里那个响亮的砰声是什么！？’
that loud pop
是那种短促、中空的爆破音或破裂声，常用来形容气球爆炸或者灯泡爆裂的声音。
That was the old wire blowing the main first floor fuse.
‘那是旧电线把一楼的主保险丝烧断了。’
blowing the main first floor fuse.
动词 blow 在这里描述了保险丝由于过载而猛烈熔断的动作。
The lobby lamp went dark! Did I break the kitchen oven too?!
‘大厅的灯灭了！我是不是把厨房的烤箱也弄坏了！？’如果要表达灯光因为停电等原因熄灭，
went dark!
就像去到一个没有光线的地方。
Oh no, I can hear Tessa calling from the dark kitchen right now!
‘哦，不，现在我就听到泰莎从漆黑的厨房里在喊！’英语中表示感官动词如 hear 或 see 时，通常用 can 来表达即时的感知：
I can hear Tessa calling
强调就是在这一刻听到。
Thirty year old cloth wire, boss. Never flip a switch before I look inside.
‘三十年前的布包电线，老板。在我检查里面之前，千万不要拨动开关。’在名词前面，表示年龄时不用复数 s，如 thirty year old，而且表示按下开关的动作总是用
flip a switch
因为它描述的是快速向上或向下的拨动动作。
Can you fix it before lunch, Graham? Please say you have spare fuses!
‘午餐前你能修好它吗，格雷厄姆？求你告诉我你有备用保险丝！’无论在家里还是在旅途中，单词 spare 放在物品前面都非常实用，表示备用或多余的：
spare fuses!
就像 spare key（备用钥匙）一样。
I can reset the kitchen in two minutes, but Room Nine needs new copper wire.
‘我两分钟内就能恢复厨房供电，但是九号房间需要新的铜线。’在英语中，表示某事在多长时间之后完成用介词 in：
in two minutes,
而 reset 指的是将配电盘恢复到原来的工作状态。
Hold the flashlight steady, Arthur. Our six day countdown just got real!
‘拿稳手电筒，亚瑟。我们这六天的倒数计时刚刚动真格了！’这是一种生动且非常现代的口语表达，意思是挑战现在变得非常严峻且真实：
just got real!
作为开启第二季的完美结尾。让我们最后再连续听一遍整个场景。
Wait one minute before touching that brass switch, Arthur.
Why wait? I remember this glass ceiling lamp. Watch how prettily it glows!
Arthur, wait! Graham has his screwdriver out!
Just one quick click... pop! Oh dear.
What was that loud pop in the hallway?!
That was the old wire blowing the main first floor fuse.
The lobby lamp went dark! Did I break the kitchen oven too?!
Oh no, I can hear Tessa calling from the dark kitchen right now!
Thirty year old cloth wire, boss. Never flip a switch before I look inside.
Can you fix it before lunch, Graham? Please say you have spare fuses!
I can reset the kitchen in two minutes, but Room Nine needs new copper wire.
Hold the flashlight steady, Arthur. Our six day countdown just got real!
亚瑟不耐烦的一按，烧断了一楼的保险丝，也证明了九号房间在周五之前需要重新铺设电线。第二季的第一集就到这里结束了；我们在第二集再见。
Catch you later!
